rules.statement: A testator's intention to include after-acquired property in a will can be inferred from the codicil, especially when the original will or codicil contains provisions that have become obsolete due to changes in the testator’s financial situation.
rules.supporting_quote: "What is more likely is that he intended to extend that clause so as to make it applicable as if it were made at the date of the codicil. This same clause also disposed of 'all cash in deposit to my credit in my No. 2 account.' Clearly the effect of the codicil is not to restrict this request to the Rs. 1,250 which was in deposit in 1913, but to make it apply to the Rs. 6,920 in deposit at the time of his death."
